fields.name: Category
fields.description: Classification of the KB article; use to filter or prioritize which KBAs apply. Allowed values: Industry Frameworks, Best Practices, Memos.

fields.name: Context Summary
fields.description: Short summary of the article context; use for quick scan when an LLM surfaces linked KBAs.

fields.name: Created by
fields.description: User or group that created the KB article; use for audit and ownership context.

fields.name: First Created
fields.description: Timestamp when the KB article was first created; use for staleness and reporting.

fields.name: Guidance
fields.description: Rich-text guidance or instructions in the KB article; primary content to surface when an LLM uses the KBA for triage or case context.

fields.name: History
fields.description: System audit history of changes to the KB article; use for compliance and troubleshooting.

fields.name: Last Updated
fields.description: Timestamp when the KB article was last updated; use for staleness and reporting.

fields.name: Last updated by
fields.description: User or group that last updated the KB article; use for audit context.

fields.name: Matching Value
fields.description: Value to match in the record (e.g. Signal Name, Signal Type, Case Name) for context-specific KBAs; not required for Global KBAs.

fields.name: Read Only
fields.description: Flag indicating the record is read-only when linked from a case; UI and automation control. Allowed value: Read Only.

fields.name: Record Type
fields.description: Type of record this KBA targets (e.g. Signal Triage); use when resolving Knowledge Base Reference from a signal. Allowed values: Signal Triage.

fields.name: Scope
fields.description: Which record type or context this KBA applies to; use to match the right article to a Signal or Case. Allowed values: Case Name, Signal Name, Signal Rule, Signal Source, Global.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Whether the KB article is enabled or disabled; use to determine if the article is active for matching. Allowed values: Enabled, Disabled.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Human-friendly title for the KB article; primary label when a Signal Triage or Case record references this KBA.
